log_level.description: Logging verbosity (0–5); higher values produce more logs.

default_auth_type.description: Default authentication method for newly created targets (none, chap, mutual_chap).

default_auth_secret.description: Fallback CHAP secret for new targets. Not used if per-target CHAP is configured.

bind_addresses.description: List of IP addresses or hostnames tgtd will bind to for incoming iSCSI connections.

targets.description: List of iSCSI targets to expose. Each target defines a storage device and access rules.

name.description: Unique iSCSI Qualified Name (IQN) or NAA-based name (e.g., iqn.2024-01.com.example:storage.disk1).

backing_store.description: Block device path (e.g., /dev/sdb) or file path (e.g., /var/lib/iscsi/disks/vm1.img) to expose as LUN 0.

driver.description: Backend driver. Use 'libiscsi' for regular block files, or 'null' for dummy targets.

removable.description: Whether the LUN is treated as removable media.

initiators.description: List of allowed initiator IQNs. If empty, all initiators are allowed (insecure).

chap.description: CHAP authentication settings. Omit to disable authentication (not recommended).

password.description: CHAP password for the incoming user (12–16 characters recommended).

mutual_password.description: CHAP password for the outgoing user.

write_cache.description: Enable write-back caching for better performance (requires UPS/firmware support for safety).

nacl.description: Explicit ACL entries (IP addresses or subnets) for additional access control beyond IQN-based allow-list.
